name: Tobias
source:
Tobias is one of the most purehearted people you will ever meet. Sure, he might scam you out of 15 gold, but were you not entertained? He adores telling stories and making those around him happy. Unfortunately for him, that often comes at the price of his freedom.

[In game description]
